description: Rename p1f's local circuit predicate so it no longer collides with the modern stdlib predicate.
rationale: The 2009 model ships a local decomposition of `circuit`, but current MiniZinc already provides that predicate in the standard library.

replacements.pattern: predicate circuit(array[int] of var int: x) =
replacements.replacement: predicate p1f_circuit(array[int] of var int: x) =

semantics_note: This preserves the model's custom decomposition and only avoids the name collision.
